title: From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.02179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weight

translated_title: 从梯度到能力：理解多教师在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）旨在将多个经强化学习训练的教师模型的优势融合到单个学生模型中，但教师信号如何影响参数变化这一问题仍未被充分探索。我们以Qwen3-1.7B为研究对象，使用四个与学生采用相同初始化、通过强化学习训练的领域教师模型，比较了梯度、优化器更新和任务学习曲线，并对SmolLM3-3B进行了额外的诊断分析。我们发现多个因素会影响教师信号。首先，损失平均会隐式地对响应进行加权：按token平均有利于更长的响应，而均衡各领域贡献会在领域内部保留这种加权方式。其次，Adam优化器的一阶矩会减小参数更新之间的差异：尽管原始梯度存在差异，教师之间的余弦相似度为0.83，不同平均规则之间的余弦相似度为0.96。第三，BF16数值舍入掩盖了微小的参数变化：约97%的FP32主权重与初始化时不同，但只有7-11%的BF16权重表现出变化。
tldr: 该论文揭示了多教师在线策略蒸馏中教师信号影响学生参数更新的三个关键机制：损失平均方式隐式加权响应长度、Adam一阶矩显著缩小教师间的更新差异、BF16精度舍入掩盖微小参数变化，从而解释了从梯度层面到学生能力形成的传导过程。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three key mechanisms shaping parameter updates in multi-teacher on-policy distillation—implicit response weighting from loss averaging, Adam's first moment homogenizing teacher differences, and BF16 rounding masking small weight changes—explaining how gradient-level signals translate into student capabilities.
